compute_chamfer_distance: compute the chamfer distance between two PyTorch 3D point clouds x and y
compute_chamfer_with_normals: compute chamfer distance between two point clouds with normals to get cosine distance of normals
compute_chamfer_with_weights: compute weighted chamfer distance between two point clouds using a per-batch weight tensor
validate_chamfer_reduction_inputs: validate that batch_reduction and point_reduction arguments are valid for chamfer distance computation
handle_pointcloud_input: handle Pointclouds objects or tensor inputs by extracting padded points, lengths, and normals
